classifier.baseline_note: LLM labels A (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) and B (gpt-4.1-nano) helped create the silver labels (consensus or haiku adjudication of A!=B), so the A/B baselines are optimistic/circular.

secondary_3class.note: the plan names this '4-class'; VARIANT_OF has 2 train items and 0 test items, so 3 classes

human_anchors.note: These are the only human-labelled numbers in this artifact; the construct is keyphrase/entity span (SemEval-2017 Task 10, SciERC), not emerging-concept term.

classifier.label_status: D2 targets are LLM-adjudicated SILVER labels (gemini-2.5-flash-lite + gpt-4.1-nano, haiku adjudication); no human gold on D2. Only the SemEval-2017/SciERC anchors are human-labelled.

d3_test.baseline_note: D3 near-duplicate items were built with token_set_ratio >= 85, so that baseline is partly circular on D3.

heldout_mesh.baseline_note: D3 near-duplicate items were built with token_set_ratio >= 85, so that baseline is partly circular on D3.

frozen.rule: choose encoder with higher in-KB recall at precision_pi(0.9) >= 0.90 (gated); tie -> MiniLM; SapBERT reported only

shift_diagnostic.F4_rule: test F1 < 0.70 or below the C-value baseline -> best CV comparison model's accept flags written as a sensitivity column; MAIN rule unchanged
shift_diagnostic.rule: if termhood-block AUC > 0.90 also compute accepted_primary_notermhood; if Jaccard(primary, notermhood) < 0.80 iteration 3 must run both as a sensitivity pair

frame_audit.note: In-domain SILVER check: model A (gemini-2.5-flash-lite, DS4 codebook) labels on all frame phrases; classifier/A disagreements adjudicated by claude-haiku-4.5. Silver = A where classifier and A agree, adjudicator label where they disagree (optimistic for the classifier by design: agreement items cannot count against it). The classifier's predictions were frozen before labels were requested.

link_thresholds.rule: choose encoder with higher in-KB recall at precision_pi(0.9) >= 0.90 (gated); tie -> MiniLM; SapBERT reported only

merger_choice.rule: F5 choice (higher D3-OOF F1) among models whose threshold meets OOF precision >= 0.90 on BOTH D3 and MeSH (plan's p_merge rule)
merger_choice.why: the D3-only threshold alone (0.506) merged topically related frame phrases into clusters of up to 70 members
